thread:
Lena (Design): Quick idea: replace bulky invoice rows with compact cards — left sparkline, middle label, right amount + chevron to expand. Figma: https://figma.com/file/compact-invoice
Omar (PM): Good for scanability. Need Org vs Project toggle and unit switch (Tokens / USD) visible in header.
Ivy (Frontend): Agree. Implementation notes: make icons 36px hit area for mobile, virtualize list for perf.
Sam (Eng): Perf guardrail: if rows > 200 auto-switch to condensed view (no sparklines). Use server flag when available.
a11y-bot: A11y: ensure accordion buttons use aria-expanded, provide focus ring, announce unit changes, and respect prefers-reduced-motion. Sparkline contrast >= 3:1.
Lena (Design): Copy: header unit toggle labeled "Display units" with tooltip. In expanded view show "Token usage (tokens)" and small USD estimate.
Omar (PM): Track events: invoice.view.mode, invoice.line.expand, invoice.units.toggle. Payload: invoice_id, line_id, scope.
Ivy (Frontend): I'll prototype keyboard nav (arrows between rows, enter to expand). Sam please spec API for condensed flag.
